description: Rejects a pending suggested action from retro.board.insights.list: the suggestion moves to rejected and no action item is created. Requires mcp:write scope.

board_id.description: The ID of the board the suggestion belongs to.

suggested_action_id.description: The ID of the suggested action to reject, from suggested_actions in retro.board.insights.list. Only suggestions with status "pending" can be rejected.

name: retro.board.suggested_actions.reject
title: Reject Suggested Action Tool
